# Welcome!

I am an MPH student in Biostatistics at Columbia University’s Mailman School of Public Health, with an expected graduation date of June 2027.

My interests include environmental epidemiology, chronic disease prevention, and quantitative methods for population health.

## About me

I am interested in using data to understand how environmental exposures affect health, particularly breast cancer risk.

This website includes my academic and professional experience and an interactive dashboard created for P8105: Data Science I.
